label: StudyE6b-mobility STAGE B: OFFLINE REPLAY OF COMMITTED RESULTS. CPU only on flash; no GPU, no model server, no inference. Adds the 4B cloud D2 arms, the device D2 arms, P2/P3/P3-noncausal/oracle keep-warm, keep-warm costs, both negative controls and the pre-registered decision rule.

decision_rule.description: Pre-registered: the keep-warm decision is NON-TRIVIAL if P3 matches P2's utility (difference CI within +/-1 pp) at significantly lower device energy, or beats P1 with a CI excluding 0, in at least one pre-specified cell (outdoor-driving or synthetic >= 5%, uplink 13.6 Mbit/s, deadline 2 or 5 s). If P2 = P1 everywhere, device-warm has no value on this workload. If P3 = P2 at equal energy, the decision is a static rule.

negative_control_a.description: Outage fraction 0 (synthetic_0pct): P3's warm fraction must go to ~0 and P2/P3 must equal P1, because the device is never the only node that can answer.
